payload.scientific_problem: Does the frozen generic anchored-replacement proposal expert autonomously produce feasible candidates on the two JAK2 delta-0.6 source molecules that did not motivate its development?
payload.primary_model_output: A complete exact-executed COMPOSE program endpoint from either the unchanged shallow Dynamic-v0 lane or the frozen anchored-replacement lane.
payload.central_claim_under_test: The coordinated delete-retain-construct proposal is a transferable structural action rather than a seed-1 endpoint lookup.
payload.validation_setting: Zero-oracle matched proposal generation on JAK2 seeds 0 and 2 at delta 0.6, with the implementation frozen after observing seed 1.
payload.primary_baseline: Unchanged shallow Dynamic-v0 proposal generation at the same 512-program budget on each source.
payload.causal_ablation: The anchored lane differs only by composing existing pendant deletion and substituted-ring construction through one retained boundary anchor; exact execution and endpoint filtering are shared.

declared_support.molecules: connected COMPOSE-supported molecular graphs with at most 40 active heavy atoms
declared_support.programs: existing generic Dynamic-v1 pendant-deletion and substituted-ring modules compiled into a protected program, plus the unchanged shallow Dynamic-v0 baseline
declared_support.runtime_inputs: source molecule, fixed generic proposal configuration and exact endpoint gate; no target route, endpoint, docking score or target-conditioned lookup
declared_support.limits: transfer within one protein only; utility remains unmeasured until a separate score-blind lock is frozen

promotion_and_kill_criteria.engineering: Every one of the 256 independent workers returns exactly once without failure, every accepted endpoint passes the unchanged compose_valid gate, and oracle calls equal zero.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.transfer_support: Anchored replacement produces at least one unique eligible endpoint on both JAK2 seeds 0 and 2.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.full_panel_yield: Anchored replacement produces at least twelve unique eligible endpoints on each source, sufficient for a matched small score-blind utility panel without regeneration.
promotion_and_kill_criteria.negative: If a source has zero anchored eligible endpoints, record the transfer failure and do not score that source under this frozen proposal expert.

payload.next_step_if_promoted: Deduplicate against exact historical charged endpoints, freeze up to twelve novel anchored endpoints per source by canonical endpoint digest before scores are loaded, then run a separately authorized small utility/FiberControl pilot.
